corrections.text: The article attributes the comparison between a 'speed limit' on recursive self-improvement and Cold War-era SALT arms-limitation treaties to Fortune ('according to Fortune'). This comparison does not appear in either cited Fortune article; it appears in Dario Amodei's own essay, which states the idea 'could be seen as analogous to the SALT treaties.' The comparison is accurate and traceable to the essay — only the citation was misattributed.
